actions.reason: 已观察到 autogen 以 exit 127 失败于 `autopoint: not found`，而前一依赖步骤安装的 gettext 包在 Ubuntu 中不提供 autopoint 命令（autopoint 是独立软件包）。因此保留既有的 deps-autotools 依赖步骤，新增一个安装 autopoint 包的 dependency 步骤，并让 autogen 同时依赖它；后续 configure 与 build 命令依据 INSTALL.generic 的 ./configure && make 保持原样。

steps.command: missing=0; for t in gcc make autoconf automake libtoolize autopoint aclocal autoheader; do command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || missing=1; done; if [ "$missing" = 1 ]; then apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gcc make autoconf automake libtool gettext pkg-config; fi
steps.source: autogen.sh:13-18 (autopoint, libtoolize, aclocal, autoconf, autoheader, automake); INSTALL:59-64 requires a C99 compiler
steps.expected: Autotools toolchain, gettext and pkg-config are available

steps.command: command -v autopoint >/dev/null 2>&1 || { apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends autopoint; }
steps.source: autogen.sh:13 invokes autopoint -f; failed log shows 'autopoint: not found' although gettext was installed, since Ubuntu ships autopoint as a separate package
steps.expected: The autopoint command used by autogen.sh is available

steps.source: autogen.sh:12-34 (generates configure via autopoint/libtoolize/aclocal/autoconf/autoheader/automake; --no-po4a skips only optional po4a man-page generation)
steps.expected: Generate the configure script and build system files from configure.ac

steps.source: INSTALL.generic:15 and 50-58 (basic installation: ./configure && make); INSTALL:37-42 refers to INSTALL.generic
steps.expected: Configure the default build for liblzma and the xz command-line tools

steps.source: INSTALL.generic:58 (type make to compile the package)
steps.expected: Build the default main targets: liblzma and the xz tools
